propositions: Claim-session provenance fields (claimed_session, claim_harness, claim_remote_session) are stamped on open→in_progress transition but never cleared on exit, causing closed/blocked/reopened tickets to report stale session holder information.

A helper function must clear all three provenance fields to None whenever a ticket exits in_progress status (to blocked, closed, open, or idea), invoked only in winning fork branches to prevent concurrent losing transitions from clearing the winner's state.
The clear operation must be applied in both the normal-update and fork-winner branches of the STATUS fold, using the same fork-winner gating logic as _fold_claimed_session to avoid race conditions.

All existing readers of the three provenance fields (llm_format, mcp_models, state defaults, TicketState typing, txn writer) are pure passthrough and do not branch on the values, making the change backward/forward compatible and safe to roll back.
